generation.rule: Fixed three-model ensemble generation. Every pixel uses the same rule; input IDs and finder scores do not choose geometry. Positive affine percentile alignment to the original model scale, preserving tails; invalid or negative teacher samples retain the original depth. No shipping asset or runtime model.

moge.name: MoGe-2 ViT-L
moge.weightLicense: MIT, verified on the live model card on October 16, 2026.

settings.input: Original browser-decoded RGB, resized with Lanczos. Official masked inverse depth; invalid depth maps to zero. Bilinear resize to original model dimensions. Built-ins are packed and unpacked with the existing unsigned-16-bit format before the field screen.

da3Large11.name: depth-anything/DA3-LARGE-1.1
da3Large11.licenseScope: Offline research only; no weights or derived depth asset ships. Both stated licenses permit this research.
da3Large11.processing: Official 504 upper-bound input processing, CPU one thread, FP32, seed zero, strict full-parameter safetensors loading with asserted shared LayerNorm aliases. Positive depth inverted, then bilinearly resampled to the original model dimensions. Original unsigned-16-bit pack/unpack only for built-in baked-asset comparison; references retain raw Float32.

decision: All four fixed combinations are cut. Every rule regresses built-in flat or order warnings. Mean and median improve all 12 reference AbsRel, RMSE, p95, and reversed-pair scores with no new holes, but still increase reference flat-pair warnings on arches and steps. No original threshold, metric, input membership, or shipping depth asset changes.
